```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Install necessary packages if you haven't already
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "vdemdata", "WDI", "broom", "car"))

library(tidyverse)  # For data wrangling
library(vdemdata)   # Access V-Dem directly in R
library(WDI)        # Access World Bank Data (GDP, GNI, Unemployment)
library(broom)      # For tidy model outputs

# 1. Fetch V-Dem Data (Example: Electoral Democracy Index)
vdem_df <- vdem %>%
  filter(year >= 2000) %>%
  select(country_name, country_text_id, year, 
         v2x_polyarchy,      # Dependent Variable: Democracy Score
         v2x_polar,          # Political Polarization
         v2x_egaldem)        # Egalitarian Democracy (Inequality proxy)

# 2. Fetch World Bank Data (GDP, GNI, Unemployment)
wb_data <- WDI(indicator = c("NY.GDP.PCAP.CD", "NY.GNP.PCAP.CD", "SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS"), 
               start = 2000, end = 2024, extra = TRUE) %>%
  rename(gdp_pc = NY.GDP.PCAP.CD, 
         gni_pc = NY.GNP.PCAP.CD, 
         unemployment = SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS)

# 3. Merge Datasets
# Note: You will need to join your WVS 'Individualism' and 'Age' index here
final_df <- vdem_df %>%
  inner_join(wb_data, by = c("country_text_id" = "iso3c", "year" = "year")) %>%
  drop_na() # Removing missing values for the regression

```

```{r multiple regression}
# Define the Multiple Regression Model
# Formula: V-Dem Score ~ Economic Factors + Social Factors + Demographic Factors
model_vdem <- lm(v2x_polyarchy ~ gdp_pc + gni_pc + unemployment + 
                 v2x_polar + age_median + individualism_score, 
                 data = final_df)

# View the Summary
summary(model_vdem)

# Get Tidy Results (Coefficients, P-values, Std Errors)
model_results <- tidy(model_vdem)
print(model_results)

```

```{r diagnostic checks}
library(car)
# Check for Multicollinearity (Variance Inflation Factor)
# If VIF > 5 or 10, your variables are too similar.
vif(model_vdem)

# Plot residuals to check for homoscedasticity
plot(model_vdem, which = 1)

```
